title: Z-Pet
summary: A pocket pixel-art virtual pet RPG built for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero
description: A pocket pixel-art virtual pet RPG built for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero (320×170 SPI display) with full PC preview support. Raise one of 5 unique starter companions, customize their coat color and name, train their battle stats, fight wild Z-Pets and Elite Bosses in the Battle Arena, listen to a built-in procedural 8-bit soundtrack, and unlock 35 Baby, Teen, and Adult evolutions shaped by how you care for them.
